text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
RZECZPOSPOLITA

- The Nafta Polska petroleum holding will carry out the sector's capital privatisation following the fusion of the CPN fuel distribution chain with the Plock and Gdansk refineries and five other refineries located in southern Poland, Nafta Polska said.

- Poland's food prices are expected to have risen by 0.2 percent from November 10 to 20 after rising 1.8 percent in the previous ten days, Central Statistical Office (GUS) deputy president Roman Sawinski said.
- The U.S.-based Hormel meat processing firm has acquired 90,000 B-series shares of the Poznan-based Pozmeat meat processing company.
- In the first ten months of this year Poland's breweries' output was at 14.253 million hectolitres, which showed nine percent growth compared with the same period last year.
- The Ostrow Wielkopolski municipality has informed the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) about entering its municipal bonds for public trading on Poland's over-the-counter (OTC) market.
NOWA EUROPA
- Polish-Finnish trade turnover in the first half of 1996 amounted to $379.3 million.
Poland's exports were worth $116.8 million and imports $262.5 million.
- Poland's gross domestic product (GDP) will grow by 5.5 percent this year as envisaged by the budget, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
- The restructuring of Poland's cooperative banking sector should end by the second quarter of 1997, the supervisory board of state-owned agricultural Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej (BGZ) said.
- The zloty's purchasing power in 1996 has decreased by 12 percent, the central bank said.
- The listed Swarzedz furniture maker's supervisory board has accepted a restructuring programme prepared by Deloitte & Touche, which now awaits creditors' approval.
- Bank Pekao SA's stake in the listed Kompap paper maker decreased from 5.33 percent to 2.87 percent following Friday's bourse session, the bank said.
ZYCIE
- A Lublin-based Polish-American joint-venture will utilise 70 percent of Lublin municipality's waste as of next year, the city president's spokesman Miroslaw Kalinowski said.
- Poland's treasury ministry will invite investors interested in buying shares of the Polfa Rzeszow and Polfa Krakow pharmaceutics' makers, the Polish Institute of Management Miroslaw Dlugosz said.
- The average Pole annually drinks 6.5 litres of fruit juice, which is almost 29 less than an average western European, a recent report by the Indicator marketing research centre said.
PARKIET
- Poland's gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 7.3 percent in the first three quarters of 1996 compared with the same period last year, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
- The Zary-based Relpol electrical engineering firm has acquired a 42-percent stake in the Elzab till maker worth 5.1 million zlotys.
